# TabVault

Features described: 0.5.0. Chrome 116+. Browser-language default, English fallback, manual English/Simplified Chinese. Three Free text sizes. Store review and distribution can lag; check the installed version.

Free: 30 manual sessions · 3 projects; Notes, tags, pins and title/URL search; JSON backup · basic Markdown and link export; Selected-page, group and pinned-tab restore; Skip open duplicates · preview differences; Preview launch editing and duplicate references; Three text sizes · local data-change undo; Optional snapshots: up to 24 hours / 50 / 4 MB.

Pro: No manual-session or project count limits; Batch-recover selected missing pages; Save named multi-window launch plans; Apply reviewed cross-session cleanup; Advanced batch organization and project launch; CSV export; Snapshots: up to 30 days / 500 / 4 MB.

Automatic snapshots are off by default. Free: up to 24 hours / 50 snapshots; Pro: up to 30 days / 500. Both share a 4 MB total snapshot limit, so actual coverage can be shorter. Snapshot cleanup does not delete manual sessions.

Saved URLs and supported tab metadata, including pinned tabs and browser groups. It does not restore passwords, logins, form inputs or unsaved page state. Launch plans open selected windows in sequence; stopping takes effect after the current window finishes. Automatic history can only restore records that were actually saved.

Applicable tax is shown at checkout. Each product is purchased separately. Existing Pro licenses include this update. Start in the extension for automatic activation after payment verification. Email recovery and existing license codes remain available.

Content stays local; no extension usage analytics or cloud sync. The website has separate traffic analytics described in its privacy policy.
